meta.scope: Columns of the nflverse play-by-play files for seasons 2000-2005 and of the nflverse games/schedules file (rows of seasons 2000-2005 used for the missingness flags). Summary-free: no counts, means, frequencies or value distributions.

definition_sources.units_coding: Written by the acquisition role from provider definitions and stored types.

play_by_play.definition: Numeric play id that when used with game_id and drive provides the unique identifier for a single play.
play_by_play.units_coding: Identifier; unique within game_id. Not a sequence counter of plays.

play_by_play.definition: Ten digit identifier for NFL game.
play_by_play.units_coding: Text 'SEASON_WW_AWAY_HOME' (WW = two-digit week); joins to games.game_id.

play_by_play.definition: Legacy NFL game ID.
play_by_play.units_coding: Ten-digit legacy NFL game identifier (YYYYMMDDNN) stored as text; joins to games.old_game_id.

play_by_play.definition: String abbreviation for the home team.
play_by_play.units_coding: Team abbreviation (current franchise abbreviations LA, LAC, LV for relocated franchises; game_id uses the abbreviations of the time).

play_by_play.definition: String abbreviation for the away team.
play_by_play.units_coding: Team abbreviation (current franchise abbreviations; see home_team).

play_by_play.definition: 'REG' or 'POST' indicating if the game belongs to regular or post season.
play_by_play.units_coding: Coded: REG = regular season, POST = postseason.

play_by_play.definition: Season week.
play_by_play.units_coding: Integer week of the season. In these files regular-season weeks run 1-17 and postseason weeks are numbered after them (18-21); season_type distinguishes them.

play_by_play.definition: String abbreviation for the team with possession.
play_by_play.units_coding: Team abbreviation of the team with possession. Team columns use current franchise abbreviations (LA, LAC, LV) for relocated franchises, whereas game_id and the games file use the abbreviations of the time (STL, SD, OAK). Empty string on some rows.

play_by_play.definition: String indicating whether the posteam team is home or away.
play_by_play.units_coding: Coded: home or away (relative to posteam).

play_by_play.definition: String abbreviation for the team on defense.
play_by_play.units_coding: Team abbreviation of the defending team (current franchise abbreviations; see posteam).

play_by_play.definition: String abbreviation for which team's side of the field the team with possession is currently on.
play_by_play.units_coding: Team abbreviation of the side of the field the ball is on; MID or 50 at midfield; empty string on some rows.

play_by_play.definition: Numeric distance in the number of yards from the opponent's endzone for the posteam.
play_by_play.units_coding: Yards from the opponent's end zone at the line of scrimmage, on a 0-100 scale (provider definition); relative to posteam.

play_by_play.definition: Date of the game.
Numeric seconds remaining in the quarter.
Numeric seconds remaining in the half.
Numeric seconds remaining in the game.
play_by_play.units_coding: Seconds remaining in the game (provider definition); regulation is 3600 seconds.

play_by_play.definition: String indicating which half the play is in, either Half1, Half2, or Overtime.
Binary indicator for whether or not the row of the data is marking the end of a quarter.
Numeric drive number in the game.
Binary indicator for whether or not a score occurred on the play.
Quarter of the game (5 is overtime).
play_by_play.units_coding: Integer quarter; 5 (and 6 for a second overtime period) denote overtime.

play_by_play.definition: The down for the given play.
play_by_play.units_coding: Integer 1-4; missing when the play has no down (e.g. kickoffs, extra points, timeouts, some penalties).

play_by_play.definition: Binary indicator for whether or not the posteam is in a goal down situation.
Time at start of play provided in string format as minutes:seconds remaining in the quarter.
play_by_play.units_coding: Game clock at the start of the play, text MM:SS, counting down within the quarter.

play_by_play.definition: String indicating the current field position for a given play.
play_by_play.units_coding: Text field position: team abbreviation followed by yard line (e.g. 'ABC 30'), or 'MID 50'.

play_by_play.definition: Numeric yards in distance from either the first down marker or the endzone in goal down situations.
play_by_play.units_coding: Yards to the first-down marker, or to the end zone in goal-to-go situations (provider definition).

play_by_play.definition: Numeric value for total yards gained on the given drive.
Detailed string description for the given play.
play_by_play.units_coding: Free-text play description from the official play-by-play.

play_by_play.definition: String indicating the type of play: pass (includes sacks), run (includes scrambles), punt, field_goal, kickoff, extra_point, qb_kneel, qb_spike, no_play (timeouts and penalties), and missing for rows indicating end of play.
play_by_play.units_coding: Coded string; see coding categories. Provider: pass includes sacks, run includes scrambles, no_play covers timeouts and penalties; missing on rows marking end of play/period. An empty-string code also occurs.

play_by_play.definition: Numeric yards gained (or lost) by the possessing team, excluding yards gained via fumble recoveries and laterals.
play_by_play.units_coding: Yards gained or lost by posteam (provider definition excludes fumble-recovery and lateral yardage).

play_by_play.definition: The closing total line for the game. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)

play_by_play.definition: The speed of the wind in miles/hour only for 'roof' = 'outdoors' or 'open'. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)

play_by_play.definition: Gives QB credit for EPA for up to the point where a receiver lost a fumble after a completed catch and makes EPA work more like passing yards on plays with fumbles.
Expected value of EPA gained after the catch, starting from where the catch was made. Zero yards after the catch would be listed as zero EPA.
Average expected yards after the catch based on where the ball was caught.
Median expected yards after the catch based on where the ball was caught.
Probability play earns positive EPA (relative to where play started) based on where ball was caught.
Probability play earns a first down based on where the ball was caught.
Probability of dropback scaled from 0 to 1.
Dropback percent over expected on a given play scaled from 0 to 100.

games.definition: A human-readable game ID. It consists of: the season, an underscore, the two-digit week number, an underscore, the away team, an underscore, the home team. This is the primary identifier for a given game and is also used in various nflverse dataframes.
The year of the NFL season. This represents the whole season, so regular season games that happen in January as well as playoff games will occur in the year after this number.
What type of game? One of REG, WC, DIV, CON, SB
games.units_coding: Coded: REG, WC, DIV, CON, SB.

games.definition: The week of the NFL season the game occurs in. Please note that the `game_type` will differ for weeks >= 18 because of the season expansion in 2021. Please use `game_type` to filter for regular season or postseason.
games.units_coding: Integer week; regular season 1-17 and postseason 18-21 for these seasons.

games.definition: The date on which the game occurred.
The day of the week on which the game occcured.
The kickoff time of the game. This is represented in 24-hour time and the Eastern time zone, regardless of what time zone the game was being played in.
games.units_coding: Text kickoff time HH:MM (US Eastern per provider documentation).

games.definition: The away team.
games.units_coding: Team abbreviation of the time (see home_team).

games.definition: The number of points the away team scored. Is NA for games which haven't yet been played.
The home team. Note that this contains the designated home team for games which no team is playing at home such as Super Bowls or NFL International games.
games.units_coding: Team abbreviation of the time (e.g. STL, SD, OAK), unlike the play-by-play team columns.

games.definition: The number of points the home team scored. Is NA for games which haven't yet been played.

Either Home if the home team is playing in their home stadium, or Neutral if the game is being played at a neutral location. This still shows as Home for games between the Giants and Jets even though they share the same home stadium.

The number of points the home team scored minus the number of points the visiting team scored. Equals h_score - v_score. Is NA for games which haven't yet been played. Convenient for evaluating against the spread bets.
The sum of each team's score in the game. Equals h_score + v_score. Is NA for games which haven't yet been played. Convenient for evaluating over/under total bets.
Binary indicator of whether or not game went to overtime.
games.units_coding: Binary 1/0 indicator that the game went to overtime.

team_season_alignment.definition: Team abbreviation as used in game_id and in the games/schedules file (abbreviations of the time, e.g. STL, SD, OAK).

Abbreviation of the same team as used in the play-by-play team columns (home_team, away_team, posteam, defteam); current franchise codes LA, LAC, LV for relocated franchises. Derived by joining games-file and play-by-play home/away codes on game_id within season.
Conference of the team in that season.

Division of the team in that season, as 'CONF Region'. Seasons 2000-2001 use the pre-2002 alignment (East, Central, West); seasons 2002-2005 use the 2002 realignment (East, North, South, West). Houston (HOU) appears from 2002.

Source of the conference/division assignment: 'nfldata:data/standings.csv@<commit>' (seasons 2002-2005) or 'wikipedia:Template:<season> <division> standings@oldid=<revision>' (seasons 2000-2001). Full provenance in registry/source_registry.json.
